name: 皮薄多汁鲜甜橙子款
description: 现摘鲜发、皮薄多汁、酸甜适口的当季甜橙生鲜套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, warm cream #FBF3E4 and soft amber #F6C453 panels for splash and infographic shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused top light with gentle front fill, soft contact shadows, appetizing natural food rendering, never harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-wood tabletop #E9DCC5 and clean white stone surface #F5F2EC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D or white, labels 10-14pt, leaf green #4E9A46 reserved for small leaf accents
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons, single amber accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and product scale across the set, whole fruit shown with one fresh green leaf where natural
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh juicy fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, warm cream #FBF3E4, amber orange accent #E87A0E, leaf green secondary accent #4E9A46 and charcoal text #2D2D2D; soft diffused top light with gentle front fill, soft contact shadows, appetizing natural food rendering with realistic citrus peel texture; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal or white; consistent rounded info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and product scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的生鲜白底主图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at eye-level, whole fruit upright with a single leaf, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill plus a soft top light, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One whole fruit with a single fresh leaf, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle, full product visible, the fruit filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete balanced composition with natural breathing margins. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill and a soft top light, soft contact shadow grounding the fruit, realistic natural peel texture. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no waxy plastic-looking skin, no floating fruit without contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用果汁飞溅一秒传达多汁的核心利益
shots.camera: eye-level with a slight low-angle tilt looking up at the fruit frozen mid-splash
shots.lighting: bright soft top light with a warm amber rim accent, crisp frozen splash highlights
shots.background: warm amber gradient panel from #F6C453 to #E87A0E
shots.props: dynamic juice splash droplets and two floating leaf accents
shots.textZone: top area about one third of the frame carrying a short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF with one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} frozen mid-splash. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Whole fruit and one cut half suspended in a dynamic juice splash, photographed at eye-level with a slight low-angle tilt looking upward, the fruit and splash filling 60-70% of the frame with the headline block in the upper third completing the composition. Bright soft top light with a warm amber rim accent, crisp frozen splash droplets. Warm amber gradient background from #F6C453 to #E87A0E. The top third carries a short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short sub-line 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no invented claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking juice, no duplicated fruit elements.

shots.intent: 用干瘪寡淡的普通果肉反衬本品饱满爆汁
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat dull light; right panel soft appetizing light
shots.background: light neutral grey-beige #EFEAE0 on both panels
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels, identical straight-on camera and framing. Left panel: a cut citrus segment looking dry, pale and pithy under flat dull light. Right panel: {product} cut open showing plump glistening segments under soft appetizing light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Light neutral grey-beige background #EFEAE0 on both panels. One short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. The fruit fills 50-60% of each panel, the labels and even margins completing each balanced panel. Negative: no fabricated test data or claims, no branded fruit, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 代入早餐餐桌的真实生活场景，强化新鲜欲
shots.camera: candid eye-level 3/4 view across a breakfast table
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle natural shadows
shots.background: matte light-wood tabletop #E9DCC5 in a bright airy kitchen
shots.props: a linen napkin and an open ceramic fruit bowl, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} arranged in an open fruit bowl on a breakfast table. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Candid eye-level 3/4 view, one or two fruits cut open beside the whole ones, the fruit-bowl scene filling 40-50% of the frame composed as one balanced candid morning tableau. Soft morning window light from the left at 5500K, gentle natural shadows. Matte light-wood tabletop #E9DCC5 in a bright airy kitchen. Props: a linen napkin and an open ceramic fruit bowl, not covering the product. Negative: no people, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered scene, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 微距果肉颗粒证明皮薄肉脆、汁水充盈
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the cut face, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing pulp vesicles and juice glisten, soft top fill
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} cut open, tight zoom on the glistening pulp vesicles. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the cut face, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing juicy pulp texture and fine juice glisten, soft top fill. Clean white stone surface #F5F2EC. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the texture detail is the whole point. One small corner annotation 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no blurry subject, no dry or plastic-looking pulp, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 俯视平铺直观展示果径与规格，消除个头疑虑
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay of whole fruit plus one cut round
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting with minimal shadow
shots.props: one cut fruit round as scale reference
shots.textZone: dimension callout lines with 2-3 short dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec screen for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Whole fruit arranged in a clean grid plus one cut round as scale reference, the fruit grid filling 65-75% of the frame with even margins. Even high-key flat lighting with minimal shadow. Clean white surface #FFFFFF. Dimension callout lines with 2-3 short dimension labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D, the callout lines and grid reading as one balanced spec layout. Negative: no unreadable tiny text, no invented measurements, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以三张安心保障卡呈现看得见的保障信息，配合实物细节降低下单顾虑

shots.props: three rounded info cards each with one thin-line icon in #E87A0E
shots.textZone: three rounded info cards each carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on layout with the product at a slight 3/4 angle in the lower area and three rounded info cards above it, each with one thin-line icon in #E87A0E, the product and cards together filling 50-60% of the frame as one balanced layout. Even clean high-key studio light. Warm cream background #FBF3E4 with a soft amber wave band #F6C453. shots.intent: 展示无品牌包装与缓冲内衬，降低运输损耗顾虑
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down into an open shipping box
shots.lighting: soft top light with gentle front fill, soft shadows
shots.background: kraft-toned surface #D9C6A5 against a warm cream backdrop #FBF3E4
shots.props: an unbranded kraft shipping box with a breathable produce liner

Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into the box, the open box filling 60-70% of the frame as one complete composition. Soft top light with gentle front fill, soft shadows, realistic fruit and cardboard texture. Kraft-toned surface #D9C6A5 against a warm cream backdrop #FBF3E4. One short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no brand names or logos on the box, no invented freshness claims, no extra text, no watermark, no plastic shrink-wrap glare.

shots.intent: 以整果组合与利益点按钮收口促单
shots.camera: group 3/4 view at eye-level, whole fruit cluster with one cut half
shots.lighting: bright soft studio light with a warm amber kick light, soft contact shadows
shots.props: fresh green leaves tucked into the fruit cluster
shots.textZone: one short CTA headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one solid rounded CTA button in charcoal #2D2D2D with white button text below the fruit
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}, a group 3/4 view at eye-level with whole fruit and one cut half clustered with fresh leaves in #4E9A46. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright soft studio light with a warm amber kick light, soft contact shadows. Amber panel background #E87A0E fading to #F6C453. The group fills 55-60% of the frame, the headline and button below completing the composition. One short CTA headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one solid rounded CTA button in charcoal #2D2D2D with white button text below the fruit. provenance.notes: 从 9 张爆款鲜橙详情切片提炼；已剥离源店铺横幅文案、二维码与会员入口、店铺徽标及专属字体版式；源图中的产地、糖度、检测等无证据信息一律不写入，图中不呈现无法核实的证据类信息，由使用方按实际资质补充；源图 6-8 仅提取其版式结构与配色。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
